    payload = case['payload']
    threshold = payload['threshold']
    calls = payload['calls']
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        if tokens <= 0:
            raise ValueError('prediction_tokens must be positive')
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        norm_gain = gain / tokens
        gain_rounded = round(gain, 6)
        norm_rounded = round(norm_gain, 6)
        diag = {'call_id': call_id, 'gain': gain_rounded, 'normalized_gain': norm_rounded, 'parseable': parseable}
        diagnostics.append(diag)
        if parseable and norm_gain >= threshold:
            accepted.append(call_id)
    return {'accepted_call_ids': accepted, 'diagnostics': diagnostics}"}
